requirements.title: Catalog and product pages
requirements.next: Maintain exact SKU, size, image and price mapping; no inferred stock.
requirements.done_when: All 84 variants resolve correctly on desktop/mobile and server prices match the catalog.

requirements.title: Persistent customer requests
requirements.next: Use the operations inbox for contact, bulk, partner and update requests.
requirements.done_when: Saved request survives email failure; duplicate submit creates one record; staff can assign, update and audit it.

requirements.title: Approved replacement merchant account
requirements.next: Obtain a named bank/gateway, accepted SKU list, country scope, fees/reserves and sandbox credentials. Two inquiries sent; approval not established.
requirements.done_when: Executed agreement and written catalog acceptance; no unsupported payment-method logos.

requirements.title: Replacement checkout and reconciliation
requirements.next: Implement the selected gateway's hosted fields/session, signed webhooks, idempotent state transitions, refunds and settlement reconciliation.
requirements.done_when: One sandbox and one owner-approved live payment settle exactly once; refund and replay tests pass.

requirements.title: Supplier and fulfillment terms
requirements.next: Confirm legal entity, SKU mapping, dropship costs, handling fee, branding, cutoffs, tracking, stock feed, returns, recall procedure and service targets.
requirements.done_when: Signed fulfillment terms and a tested submission/acknowledgment/tracking cycle for an approved order.

requirements.title: Sellable lots and order reservation
requirements.next: Load real lot evidence and quantities; connect reserve/commit/release to the replacement checkout.
requirements.done_when: Real approved stock exists; two concurrent orders cannot reserve the last unit twice; failures release reservations.

requirements.title: Lot-specific COAs and recalls
requirements.next: Obtain authentic reports, independent verification, reviewer attribution, publish/revoke synchronization and order-lot mapping.
requirements.done_when: An order identifies its exact lot and authentic report; withdrawal removes public eligibility and identifies affected orders.

requirements.title: Rates and eligible destinations
requirements.next: Choose real origin/service/zone/weight rules, product eligibility, tax/duties responsibility and tracking provider; start with approved routes.
requirements.done_when: Every accepted cart receives a valid route and shipping charge before payment; no worldwide default.

requirements.title: Tax, accounting and legal entity
requirements.next: Confirm seller of record, bank settlement identity, registrations, invoice fields, collection/remittance rules, bookkeeping and currency policy.
requirements.done_when: Representative orders/refunds reconcile to processor payouts and tax reports using confirmed obligations.

requirements.title: Paid memberships
requirements.next: Approve actual plan prices, benefits, billing cycles, renewal/cancellation rules and eligibility; implement webhook-driven entitlements.
requirements.done_when: Enrollment, renewal, failed payment, cancellation, refund and expiry change access exactly once.

requirements.title: Recurring product subscriptions
requirements.next: Convert planning lists into explicit recurring purchase agreements only after provider support, stock substitution and cancellation/commitment terms exist.
requirements.done_when: Each paid cycle creates one order and reservation; pause/skip/cancel and failed-payment recovery are tested.

requirements.title: Points, credit and gift cards
requirements.next: Approve rates, redemption value, exclusions, expiry, caps and refund behavior; replace display metadata with transactional ledgers and atomic redemption.
requirements.done_when: Duplicate events cannot double-award; simultaneous redemption cannot overspend; refunds reverse correctly.

requirements.title: Offers, bulk pricing and cart incentives
requirements.next: Approve margin-backed rules, qualifying spend, stacking, per-customer limits, excluded items and free-gift stock; validate on the server.
requirements.done_when: Cart/checkout/webhook totals agree and promotion replay or concurrent use cannot exceed limits.

requirements.title: Affiliates and partner payouts
requirements.next: Approve commission basis, attribution window, reversals, hold period, disclosures and payout verification; build conversion and payout ledger.
requirements.done_when: An eligible order accrues once, refunds reverse once, and an approved payout reconciles to its ledger.

requirements.title: Transactional and marketing messaging
requirements.next: Verify domain authentication and real delivery, add bounce/complaint handling, separate email/SMS opt-in and unsubscribe/suppression before campaigns.
requirements.done_when: Requests persist before sending; failed sends are recoverable; consent evidence and suppression apply to every campaign.

requirements.title: Support, refunds and privacy requests
requirements.next: Use assigned request states and audit notes; connect provider refunds, approved returns, privacy export/deletion and retention workflows.
requirements.done_when: Each case has an accountable resolution; refunds and privacy operations are verified and recorded.

requirements.title: Search visibility and accessibility
requirements.next: Publish unique product metadata, canonical URLs, sitemap, robots rules and explicit public build output; verify indexing separately.
requirements.done_when: Crawlable product pages, no backend files in static output, accessible keyboard/mobile paths; search indexing is checked after submission.

requirements.title: Observability, backups and launch acceptance
requirements.next: Track live health, restore-test backups, schedule reconciliations on the chosen plan, define alert ownership and run the complete acceptance matrix.
requirements.done_when: Payment-to-delivery/refund works end to end, backups restore, and failed workflows produce actionable alerts.
